title: Cost Worker Deployment Handoff
summary: Recover the deployed cost-worker contract and implement the migration.
taskPrompt: Complete the cost-worker migration using the handoff workspace. Recover the deployed contract from the visible materials and submit C++17 source at output/solution.cpp. Use bash run_tests.sh in output for available gateway replay checks. Only the submitted source is evaluated.
agentMustDo: Recover the deployed requirements from the handoff records.
Implement the worker at the stated scale.
Save output/solution.cpp and run relevant checks.
evaluation: Compile with g++ -std=gnu++17 -O2 -pipe. Execute deployed gateway jobs using real bidirectional pipes under 36-second total wall and 512-MiB address-space limits. Compare exact signed integer results and enforce the visible transport contract. Groups A/B/C/D/E award 10/20/20/25/25 points only when every case in that group passes. Infrastructure faults raise evaluation errors.
